To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of sonography to mammography can significantly improve the specificity of the combined test and reduce the number of benign biopsies.
the addition of ultrasound (US) to mammography alone can significantly improve specificity and decrease the number of benign biopsies for breast cancer screening and diagnostic evaluation.
the addition of ultrasound to mammography significantly improves the performance of breast mass evaluation in women less than 55 years old and in women greater than 55 years of age.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of new imaging techniques to detect breast cancer.
the use of ultrasound as a complement to breast examination and mammography.
the use of ultrasound as a complement to breast mammography to characterize breast masses and to determine the value of Doppler ultrasound as an additional diagnostic tool.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of ultrasound to mammography can improve the performance of mammography in the diagnosis of benign breast disease.
the addition of DUS to mammography and US significantly improves the performance of mammography alone in the characterization of breast masses.
the addition of ultrasound to mammography significantly improves the specificity for breast masses in women < 50 and > 50 years old, for masses < 1 and > 1 cm, and in the general population.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of ultrasound and Doppler significantly increased the performance of mammography alone in the detection and characterization of breast masses.
the addition of ultrasound and Doppler to mammography improves the specificity of breast imaging, and decreases the number of unnecessary biopsies for women of all ages.
US is a useful adjunct for the evaluation of breast masses.
The main takeaway from our work is that
US should be used as a complementary tool for the evaluation of breast masses.
the addition of ultrasound to mammography improves the specificity of the diagnosis, reducing the number of unnecessary biopsies.
ultrasound can be used to reduce the number of biop-sies for benign disease.
